A studio that teaches,
not a platform that sells.

Web Academy exists to teach the web to the people who build it — in rooms small enough that the work gets looked at.

The studio, Marlborough Yard · photographed by the faculty

Why we exist

Online education solved access and lost accountability. We kept the access and put the room back.

Every cohort is built the same way: a written rubric, a small number of people, one live session a week, and an artefact at the end. Nothing about that is novel. It is simply expensive to do properly, and most platforms have optimised for the opposite.

The mark

The Web Academy mark is a single unbroken line folded into a W. Continue its lines and the loop completes into a fingerprint — the arch and the loop are two of its three basic patterns. The ring is the world in the tagline.

Governance

Independent, faculty-owned, no external investors. Accounts filed annually.

Accreditation

Cohort certificates are verifiable by ID. Assessment is criterion-referenced against a published rubric.
